cards.title: The Gridlock
cards.description: Inside a Grab car on Jalan Tun Razak. Myvi cutting lanes, motorcycles weaving. Your phone explodes — GoLancar's routing engine crashed. 500K users stranded. The driver turns: 'Sesak gila, boss. Boleh lama ni... unless you tau shortcut.'
cards.image_prompt: Interior of a Grab car stuck in a Kuala Lumpur traffic jam on Jalan Tun Razak, motorcycle and e-hailing motorcycles weaving between bumpers, a stressed developer holding a phone full of red alerts, warm sunset tones with neon accents, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Crash Alert
cards.description: CRITICAL: routing engine failed past 400K concurrent users. Every ETA is offline — for developers, a null pointer; for the business, 500K rides frozen at once.
cards.image_prompt: A phone lock screen full of red CRITICAL alerts and a stack trace, urgent glow, single object on dark background

cards.title: Pak Din (Grab Driver)
cards.description: Your driver, stuck in the same sesak and worried about his rating. Full of Kuala Lumpur wisdom — and a tip about a faster lane, if you can find the LRT card.
cards.image_prompt: A friendly middle-aged Malaysian ride-hailing driver turning from the front seat with a warm grin, car interior at dusk, single character portrait

cards.title: Laptop
cards.description: Your work laptop — repo cloned, editor open, incident channel buzzing. Everything you need to ship a fix, right here in the back seat. → You'll need this to access the toll system ahead.
cards.image_prompt: An open developer laptop covered in stickers showing a code editor and an incident channel, glowing screen, single object on dark background

cards.title: Requirements Tollbooth
cards.description: A highway toll plaza. Digital signs: 'DEFINE YOUR FIX TO PROCEED.' Regular lanes are queued. Far left: a LRT-only lane, empty. A mamak vendor waves you over. A smaller sign glows above the fork: '💡 You can switch lanes anytime — nothing you've done is lost.'
cards.image_prompt: A highway toll plaza at dusk with digital lane signs reading DEFINE YOUR FIX, long queues in the regular lanes and an empty far-left LRT-only lane, a mamak coffee stall beside the barrier, warm sunset palette with neon, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Crash Report
cards.description: Impact is scoped to the routing service only — matching and ETAs depend on it; storage and payments are healthy. Fix the failure, add graceful degradation. Don't rebuild what isn't broken.
cards.image_prompt: A detailed incident report on a laptop screen with a service dependency diagram and the word SCOPED highlighted, single object on dark background

cards.title: Pak Ali (Mamak Vendor)
cards.description: Toll-plaza mamak vendor whose nephew swears by an AI assistant, Kiro. Show adaptive, focused thinking and he'll hand you a LRT pass to the express lane.
cards.image_prompt: A cheerful Malaysian mamak coffee vendor leaning over his stall beside a toll barrier, holding up a RapidKL LRT pass, warm evening light with neon, single character portrait

cards.title: Fix Scope Defined
cards.description: You spell it out: S-C-O-P-E. The sign turns green — 'Routing fix only. No rewrites, no migrations.' The overpass on-ramp opens. The boundary of the work is set.

cards.title: The LRT Lane
cards.description: The express lane is open. Empty asphalt stretches ahead while everyone else crawls. A sign reads: 'AI NAVIGATOR ACTIVE — KIRO READY.'
cards.image_prompt: An empty RapidKL LRT express lane stretching ahead beside crawling traffic, an overhead sign reading AI NAVIGATOR ACTIVE, motion blur, single object on dark background

cards.title: Exact Root Cause
cards.description: Cross-referencing the crash alert with the report pinpoints the line: an unguarded null when the routing pool saturates past 400K. Now you know exactly what to fix.
cards.image_prompt: A code diff highlighting a single null-dereference line with a red marker, single object on dark background

cards.title: AI Assistant Activated
cards.description: You load the LRT terminal on your laptop. Kiro, your AI assistant, boots up: 'Context received. I can propose a plan whenever you're ready.'

cards.title: LRT Pass
cards.description: A RapidKL LRT pass from Pak Ali. It opens the Express Lane — the AI Navigator route where Kiro proposes and you decide. → Use this to unlock the AI Navigator express lane instead of designing everything by hand.
cards.image_prompt: A blue RapidKL LRT transit pass card with a bus logo and a magnetic stripe, single object on dark background

cards.title: Scope Document
cards.description: A clear one-page scope definition. → You'll need this to validate the AI's proposal.
cards.image_prompt: A single-page scope document with a highlighted boundary box, single object on dark background

cards.title: Lane-Switch Sign
cards.description: 💡 You can switch lanes anytime — nothing you've done is lost. Take the overpass and design by hand, or grab a LRT pass for the AI express lane. Both roads reach the same fix, and any work you've already done carries over. Pick the pace that fits; you're never locked in.
cards.image_prompt: A friendly illuminated highway gantry sign above a forking road reading YOU CAN SWITCH LANES ANYTIME, an arrow curving between a manual overpass and an express LRT lane, warm reassuring glow, single object on dark background

cards.title: Architecture Blueprint
cards.description: A fully hand-designed architecture. Thorough and complete. → Needed to trace the crash in the Log Jam ahead.
cards.image_prompt: A rolled architecture blueprint with layered diagrams, single object on dark background

cards.title: Crash Timeline
cards.description: The full crash sequence, reconstructed by hand — deploy, spike, overload, failure, cascade. → Needed to start construction.
cards.image_prompt: A reconstructed incident timeline with ordered event markers, single object on dark background

cards.title: Context Brief
cards.description: AI-analyzed context summary — Kiro's read on the crash. → Present this to merge back onto the Construction Lane.
cards.image_prompt: A concise AI-generated context brief with key facts highlighted, single object on dark background

cards.title: Validated Spec
cards.description: Human-approved specification. The AI proposed, you validated. → Required for verification.
cards.image_prompt: An approved specification document with a green human-approval stamp, single object on dark background

cards.title: Triage Report
cards.description: Tasks sorted: AI handles, you decide, skip the rest. → Proves you understand the workflow.
cards.image_prompt: A triage report with three labeled columns for AI, human, and skip, single object on dark background

cards.title: Quality Stamp
cards.description: Dual-loop verified. Sensors passed. Reviewer passed. YOU passed it. → Required to enter the Learning Loop.
cards.image_prompt: A glowing green quality-approved stamp, single object on dark background

cards.title: Learning Rules
cards.description: Encoded rules for next time. The system just got smarter. → Deploy with confidence.
cards.image_prompt: A rule ledger card glowing with saved entries, single object on dark background

cards.title: The Mamak
cards.description: Pak Ali's roadside mamak. Stranded commuters swap stories over teh tarik and maggi. A whiteboard holds notes from developers who've been stuck here before.
cards.image_prompt: A cozy Malaysian roadside mamak food stall at dusk with commuters sharing teh tarik and maggi, a whiteboard covered in developer notes, a small TV, warm neon glow, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Mamak Whiteboard
cards.description: Teams using an AI assistant like Kiro report fix times dropping from days to hours. The recipe: right-sized process, parallel Bolts, and AI verification before the human gate.
cards.image_prompt: A mamak whiteboard covered in handwritten notes and arrows about faster fixes, single object on dark background

cards.title: Fellow Commuter
cards.description: A developer from another company, also stuck in the sesak. She used the AI Navigator on her last incident and is happy to share what it was like.
cards.image_prompt: A relaxed Malaysian developer sitting at a mamak table with a coffee and a laptop, gesturing as she tells a story, single character portrait

cards.title: Mamak TV
cards.description: Local news: 'GoLancar outage strands commuters citywide.' The clock in the corner keeps ticking. Everyone in the mamak glances at you.
cards.image_prompt: A small mamak TV showing a breaking-news banner about a ride-hailing outage, single object on dark background

cards.title: Architecture Overpass
cards.description: A massive overpass. You design the full fix yourself — every component, every connection. Below, a LRT bus glides past. A passenger is already coding.
cards.image_prompt: A wide highway overpass at dusk with architecture blueprints pinned across concrete pillars, a developer studying them, a RapidKL bus gliding below with a passenger coding, warm and cool contrast, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Architecture Designed
cards.description: You lay out the whole path by hand and check every connection. Solid work — it just took focus and time. The road forward opens.

cards.title: The Bus Window
cards.description: Through the window — a developer with an AI assistant, Kiro, already past this stage. The AI drafts; the human points and approves. Only the parts that need human judgment are left to the human.
cards.image_prompt: A view through a bus window of a developer collaborating with a glowing AI assistant projecting architecture diagrams, single object on dark background

cards.title: Overpass Exit — LRT Pass
cards.description: A LRT stop sits at the bottom of the ramp, with a spare pass on the railing. It's never too late to try the express lane — nothing you've done is lost by switching.

cards.title: The Log Jam
cards.description: Traffic completely stopped. To move forward, you trace exactly what went wrong — step by step, event by event. The crash logs are scattered across your screen like debris on the road.
cards.image_prompt: A completely gridlocked Kuala Lumpur intersection at dusk with scattered glowing log fragments overlaid like debris, a developer piecing together a timeline, warm and cool contrast, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Timeline Traced
cards.description: Event by event, the crash makes sense: deploy, spike, overload, failure, cascade. Thorough work — done entirely by hand.

cards.title: Manual Tracing
cards.description: Kiro does this analysis in seconds by scanning the workspace. Doing it by hand is thorough — but time-consuming.
cards.image_prompt: A screen comparing a slow manual log trace with an instant AI workspace scan, single object on dark background

cards.title: The Express Lane
cards.description: The RapidKL LRT lane — empty, smooth, fast. Kiro, your AI assistant, lights up: 'Context loaded. Plan ready. Approve or adjust?' This is AI proposing. You deciding.
cards.image_prompt: The interior of a RapidKL LRT bus gliding down an empty express lane while traffic crawls alongside, a laptop showing a glowing AI assistant, Kiro, with a plan, fast motion streaks, warm and cool contrast, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Context Provided
cards.description: You feed Kiro exactly what the crash needs and hold back the noise. The proposal snaps into focus. Right context in, right plan out.

cards.title: Bolt Plan Approved
cards.description: You approve the plan: B-O-L-T-S. Three independent units dispatched in parallel. Hours, not weeks, because they run concurrently. The LRT drops you at the Construction Lane.

cards.title: Parallel Bolts
cards.description: A bolt is an independent unit of work that Kiro executes in parallel — 3 bolts running simultaneously means 3 hours, not 9. Here, three Bolts run at once: Cache fix (2h), Route patch (3h), Load test (1h). Because they run concurrently, elapsed time is 3 hours — the longest Bolt — not the 6 you'd wait for running them one after another.
cards.image_prompt: A dashboard showing three parallel build lanes labeled Bolt 1, 2, 3 each with an hours-based progress bar, single object on dark background

cards.title: The Audit Trail
cards.description: Every proposal logged. Every approval timestamped. Kiro moves fast, but nothing it does is invisible and nothing proceeds without a recorded human 'yes.'
cards.image_prompt: An audit-trail ledger listing AI proposals and timestamped human approvals, secure aesthetic, single object on dark background

cards.title: Construction Lane
cards.description: A construction zone. Terminal ready. Screen shows: 'SPEC READY — VALIDATE.' Whether you designed it yourself or the AI proposed it — you're the final judge.
cards.image_prompt: A roadside construction zone rebuilding a Kuala Lumpur highway, a makeshift coding terminal between orange traffic cones, a screen reading SPEC READY VALIDATE, cranes and scaffolding, warm dusk lighting, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Spec Validated
cards.description: You approve the good items and reject the scope creep. What remains is exactly right. You were the gate, and you held the line.

cards.title: Work Triaged
cards.description: You sorted the work: the AI takes the routine, you keep the judgment calls, and the noise gets skipped. Right-sized effort for a scoped fix.

cards.title: The Test Plan
cards.description: Automated sensors will verify regressions and errors. But approving the logic? That's you. Speed comes from the machine; judgment stays human.
cards.image_prompt: A test plan on a monitor with automated sensor checks and a human approval checkbox, single object on dark background

cards.title: Kiro (AI Assistant)
cards.description: Kiro, your AI development assistant, projected over the desk. It leads a team of specialist agents, proposes in parallel Bolts, and never proceeds without your approval.
cards.image_prompt: A friendly holographic AI assistant named Kiro projected above a coding desk, soft glowing blue, gesturing at parallel task streams, single character portrait

cards.title: Verification Checkpoint
cards.description: An automated checkpoint. Sensors scan. A reviewer flags. Three layers before your final call. Sign: 'NO CODE SHIPS WITHOUT VERIFICATION — AND WITHOUT YOU.'
cards.image_prompt: A road checkpoint at night with automated scanner gantries, green and red lights above each lane, a sign reading NO CODE SHIPS WITHOUT VERIFICATION AND WITHOUT YOU, cool blue lighting with warm accents, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Dual-Loop Sensors
cards.description: Layer 1 (deterministic sensors) complete. Layer 2 (AI reviewer) complete. Two machine checks resolved before anything reaches Layer 3: YOU.
cards.image_prompt: A checkpoint console showing two automated verification layers passing and a third labeled HUMAN, single object on dark background

cards.title: Issues Addressed
cards.description: Three real issues fixed before they cascade; the cosmetic flag ignored — it was never a bug. The reviewer agent goes green. One gate remains: you.

cards.title: Approved to Ship
cards.description: Sensors passed. Reviewer approved. You type the final word — S-H-I-P — the human gate. Logged with your name and the timestamp.

cards.title: The Learning Loop
cards.description: Fix deployed — but the process doesn't end at shipping. Kiro asks: 'What rules should I remember for next time?' Each correction becomes a permanent rule. On the wall, a banner reads: 'THE SYSTEM ADAPTS ITS PROCESS DEPTH TO MATCH EACH PROBLEM.'
cards.image_prompt: A calm debrief space overlooking clearing Kuala Lumpur traffic, a glowing AI assistant, Kiro, recording rules into a memory ledger while a developer nods, warm hopeful lighting, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: System Taught
cards.description: Each decision you made becomes a rule Kiro keeps. Teach it once, and it never needs re-explaining. The next Bolt starts smarter.

cards.title: Learning Summary
cards.description: Teach once, never re-explain. Every correction becomes hierarchical memory the system reuses. Governance and speed, together.
cards.image_prompt: A memory ledger filling with rules derived from human decisions, glowing entries, single object on dark background

cards.title: Adaptive by Design
cards.description: The banner spells out the whole philosophy: the system adapts its process depth to match each problem. A tiny fix gets a light touch; a risky one gets the full gate. It doesn't force one rigid process — it adapts. Remember that word. It's the one thing every rule you just taught has in common.
cards.image_prompt: A glowing wall banner reading THE SYSTEM ADAPTS ITS PROCESS DEPTH TO MATCH EACH PROBLEM above a dial that scales process depth up and down, single object on dark background

cards.title: Deployment Terminal
cards.description: GoLancar HQ. The big screen lights up: 500K ETAs restored. Traffic flowing. You did it.
cards.image_prompt: A gleaming GoLancar HQ terminal at golden hour with a huge screen showing Kuala Lumpur's map reconnecting, a deployment keypad console, traffic flowing again outside, triumphant warm lighting, isometric digital illustration

cards.title: Final Command
cards.description: One word to ship — the word that defines everything you learned: ADAPT. You commit it, and the routing engine restarts clean. Across Kuala Lumpur, ETAs flicker back to life.

cards.title: Traffic Cleared
cards.description: 500K rides reconnected before rush hour ended. However you got here — every turn by hand, or Kiro proposing while you decided — the fix was right, verified, and logged. Selamat, developer. The sesak is clearing.
